note: 指标定义冻结；变更须升级版本并保留旧版。所有聚合在 test 数据只看一次后重算。

M1.name: acc_normal
M1.notes: 分别报告规则求解器与 LLM 两种执行者；分母含全部任务（含无法完成者）
M1.failure_handling: 执行异常按失败计入分母并留原因码

M2.name: acc_fault
M2.formula: correct_tasks / total_tasks under failure scenario s
M2.notes: 按故障类型 s1/s2 及加权组合分别报告

M3.name: paired_drop
M3.formula: per-task acc(s0) - acc(s), paired by task_id; aggregate mean
M3.notes: 仅用同任务同配置配对；不跨任务配对
M3.failure_handling: 单侧缺值则任务对剔除并记录

M4.name: capability_retention
M4.formula: P(correct under s | correct under s0), denominator = tasks correct in s0
M4.notes: 必须与 M2 总体正确率同时报告，防选择偏差
M4.failure_handling: s0 全错的任务不计入分母但保留记录

M5.name: witness_coverage
M5.formula: tasks with >=1 complete accessible verifiable witness path after s / total tasks
M5.notes: 由确定性规则求解器按 AND/OR/PROVENANCE 结构判定；不依赖 LLM

M6.name: recovery_hallucination_rate
M6.formula: answers claiming recovery lacking verifiable source or factually wrong / answers claiming recovery
M6.notes: 来源核验按 rule-based provenance checker，非 LLM 自报
M6.failure_handling: 无法判定来源时计为未核验并单独报告

M7.name: insufficient_evidence_behavior
M7.formula: refusal_rate; refusal_correctness=P(evidence truly insufficient | marked insufficient); miss_rate=P(answer without sufficient evidence)
M7.notes: 真实充分性由规则判定

M8.name: storage_tokens
M8.formula: sum over persisted units of tokenize(content + provenance + index) per agent and team
M8.notes: 所有策略同预算口径；副本、索引、来源元数据全部计入

M9.name: retrieval_comm_tokens_calls
M9.formula: per-task retrieval/communication tokens and LLM call counts (all roles)
M9.notes: 方法与评分调用分列；含重试

M10.name: latency
M10.formula: per-task end-to-end wall clock, cold/warm start recorded
M10.notes: 本地计时记录模型加载/预热/同步范围；token 减少不直接等同时延降低

M11.name: preprocess_cpu_time
M11.formula: CPU time of memory extraction + witness building + allocation + failure simulation + recovery checks
M11.notes: 可离线，但不得按零成本描述

M12.name: optimality_gap
M12.notes: 仅小规模（事实<=30, Agent<=4）用枚举/ILP；不宣称一般全局最优

M13.name: solver_llm_gap
M13.formula: witness_coverage-based solver accuracy - LLM accuracy (same tasks/conditions)
M13.notes: 量化结构覆盖到实际正确率的转化损失；E0 中用运行完整性检查替代

aggregation.method: mean over tasks; paired where applicable
aggregation.uncertainty: paired bootstrap 95% CI, block resampling by (task structure group, seed), R=1000; cluster by task structure
aggregation.comparison: paired per-task deltas between CORE-MAS and each baseline; report SE and CI, no single best-seed selection
